name: REMA
scenario: Anaphylaxis without skin mastocytosis · REMA score
whatItMeasures: Score from the Spanish Network on Mastocytosis that predicts clonal mast cell activation disorders in patients with anaphylaxis without skin mastocytosis, to select patients for bone marrow examination. A reassessment of 1204 patients found high sensitivity (87%-90%) but limited specificity (34%-35%).

name: EREFS
scenario: Eosinophilic esophagitis · Endoscopic grading system (EREFS)
whatItMeasures: Endoscopic grading of four major features (rings, furrows, exudates, edema) plus stricture and crepe-paper esophagus, giving common nomenclature and severity scores for disease activity.

name: EoEHSS
scenario: Eosinophilic esophagitis · Histology scoring system (EoEHSS)
whatItMeasures: Biopsy score of eight features (eosinophil density, basal zone hyperplasia, eosinophil abscesses, eosinophil surface layering, dilated intercellular spaces, surface epithelial alteration, dyskeratotic epithelial cells, lamina propria fibrosis), each graded for severity and staged for extent from 0 (normal) to 3.

name: EEsAI
scenario: Eosinophilic esophagitis, adults · Symptom-based activity index (EEsAI)
whatItMeasures: Patient-reported activity index of 7 items on dysphagia, behavioral adaptation to dysphagia and pain on swallowing, with a 7-day recall.
